description: Statement group metadata driving v7 statement-grouped dashboard rendering and PDF export. fs_page_order is the canonical sort key across groups; sortOrder is the within-group sort key on each finding.

groups.label: Cover & Table of Contents
groups.section_note: Entity identity, period, presentation header. Qualitative mismatches are ALWAYS CRITICAL regardless of dollar impact.

groups.label: Statement of Assets and Liabilities
groups.section_note: Balance-sheet equivalent for an investment company. Investments at fair value, receivables, payables, partners' capital. Tie-out to Schedule of Investments mandatory.

groups.label: Statement of Operations
groups.section_note: Investment income, expenses, realized and unrealized gain/loss. Net change must tie to Statement of Changes.
typical_sections: Net increase/decrease in partners' capital from operations

groups.key: Statement of Changes in Partners Capital
groups.label: Statement of Changes in Partners' Capital
groups.section_note: Roll-forward of partners' capital by class. Capital contributions, distributions, allocations, ending balance MUST tie to SOAL.

groups.label: Statement of Cash Flows
groups.section_note: Often elected out under ASC 946-205-45-2 when the fund meets the four scope criteria. If presented, indirect method standard; reconciliation to net increase in partners' capital required.

groups.label: Schedule of Investments
groups.section_note: Detail of investments at fair value with classification by industry/geography. >5% of net assets MUST be disclosed by name per ASC 946-210-50-6. Tie-out to SOAL Investments line mandatory.

groups.label: Notes to Financial Statements
groups.section_note: Disclosure infrastructure. Significant accounting policies, fair value hierarchy, related parties, commitments, subsequent events, recently issued ASUs.

groups.label: Financial Highlights
groups.section_note: ASC 946-205-50 ratios. IRR (when required), expense ratio, net investment income ratio. Per partner-class breakouts when capital structure differs.

groups.label: Cross-Statement Findings
groups.section_note: Findings spanning multiple statements that cannot be cleanly localized (e.g., consolidation scope inconsistencies, period-end events affecting multiple primary statements). Rendered last so the controller knows to look at it after the per-statement review.
